div.div: DML write sets, relationships, guards and retry behavior. Each TX is an implementation contract, not a stored procedure already installed.

display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Authorized event editor; fixed/percent rules, dates, limit, applicability valid. Lowered
limit cannot undercut already consumed/reserved allowance.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock organization/event then campaign and affected reservations.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT/UPDATE campaign, promo_code, eligibility joins; immutable redemptions untouched;
audit and optional availability/quote update.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Campaign/type/code/reservation composite keys keep same event. Redemptions remain after
refund and continue counting toward lifetime max.
FAILURE / RETRY
Disabling while a checkout is pending blocks discounted fulfillment; never silently charge
more. Old order discount snapshots and attribution are unchanged.

div.div: TX-18 / Create support case, message, attach file, assign/resolve/escalate

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 218px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Requester owns/accesses linked context; event/order/ticket context must be mutually
consistent. Assigned user must have current support/admin permission.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Lock relevant auth/org/event if event-scoped; then case. For platform case lock requester
organization/case.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT case/message/attachment; INSERT case_change for status/assignment/escalation; reopen
on requester reply; INSERT notification/broadcast outbox; assign persisted cursor order
(created_at,id).
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Composite FKs align context event; TX checks ticket belongs linked order when both
supplied. Participants are derived requester/current support staff/platform escalation, not
untrusted client IDs.
FAILURE / RETRY
File must be clean and uploader/context authorized. Same client_message_id deduplicates;
connection reconnect reads persisted messages. Revoked staff cannot subscribe/download even
if formerly assigned.

div.div: TX-19 / Store file, generate PDF/manifest and clean failed uploads

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 660px; margin-left: 64px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Purpose, content, type/size/count limits and storage owner checked; protected downloads
always reauthorize linked business record.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Reserve stored_file row in short TX; upload/scan/render outside TX; lock metadata/business
row to attach.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT stored_file pending/quarantined; upload object with checksum; mark clean only after
validation; INSERT event_media/support_attachment or update
ticket.pdf_file_id/offline_package.file_id; cleanup orphan objects asynchronously.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
DB stores object_key, not blobs or public URL. Delete object only after references checked;
mark metadata deleted instead of cascading business history.
FAILURE / RETRY
Remote file writes cannot be rolled back atomically with PostgreSQL; use pending state,
idempotent object keys, reconciliation and orphan cleanup. Never expose quarantined
content.

div.div: TX-20 / Issue offline package and reconcile operation batch

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 654px; height: 1px; padding-top: 736px; margin-left: 804px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.div:
GUARDS
Scanner session/current assignment valid; package unexpired and same device/event; attendee
proof must still satisfy online rules at final acceptance.
LOCK / CONSISTENCY
Download under event snapshot read consistency. Reconcile each operation with
auth/org/event locks, then ticket/confirmation/check-in; bounded batch, per-operation
results.
DATABASE WRITES
INSERT offline_package/file; on upload INSERT offline_operation before resolution; valid
check-in calls TX-11, reverse calls TX-12; update result and optionally INSERT
sync_conflict; refresh snapshot.
RELATIONSHIP EFFECT
Untrusted claimed IDs deliberately have no FK so invalid scans can be recorded.
resolved_ticket_id and accepted_check_in_id are real FKs. Unique device operation ID
survives repeated package upload.
FAILURE / RETRY
Same key/different hash rejects. Revoked assignment, expired session/proof/package,
cancelled/refunded ticket or duplicate admission -> rejection/conflict, no central
admission. Device time never overwrites server order.
